free_transfer_state.calculation: Replayed from official transfer counts, hit costs and transfer-chip use.

captaincy.principle: Expected FPL points is primary; 10+ probability and upper-tail points break close calls.

launch_validation.principle: A launch squad cannot be marked ready while any high-severity mapping, projection, squad, route or captaincy check is unresolved.

strategy_comparison.label: Balanced
strategy_comparison.description: Maximise expected points while retaining useful bench depth.

strategy_comparison.label: Aggressive
strategy_comparison.description: Give extra weight to upside and lower ownership.

strategy_comparison.label: Ownership-protected
strategy_comparison.description: Give extra weight to highly owned players to limit early rank volatility.

planned_transfer_route.objective: Maximise discounted expected starting-XI and captain points, net of transfer hits and short-horizon transfer uncertainty.
planned_transfer_route.recommendation_reason: Hold: no transfer route clears the minimum decision-adjusted edge.
assumptions: Player prices are held constant across the planning horizon.
Only same-position transfers are considered, preserving squad structure.
No chip is assumed within the route.
Later Gameweeks are discounted because forecasts become less certain.
Every planned transfer carries a small uncertainty cost, with an additional penalty for selling and quickly rebuying the same player.

initial_squad_plan.selection_policy: Balanced is the default recommendation; aggressive and ownership-protected structures are retained as explicit alternatives.
assumptions: The £100.0m initial budget and standard 2-5-5-3 squad structure apply.
No more than three players may be selected from one club.
Prices are held constant across the six-Gameweek planning horizon.
The output is regenerated as official prices, fixtures, availability and context change before the Gameweek 1 deadline.

chip_indicators.reason: Phase 18 compares each available chip with the no-chip transfer routes, accounts for half-season expiry and enforces one chip per Gameweek.

gameweek_operations.change_summary: No material change since the previous report.
